column1: # Walltimes for the August-environment sweep (profile aug2026), seeded from the
# original July/August 2026 runs before any aug2026 case had run.
#   walltime = 2.25 x 13 calls x t/call + compile allowance (Reactant 30 min,
#              Enzyme 60 min: Enzyme 0.13.198 compiles for ~30-36 min) + 30 min margin,
#              rounded up to 30 min, at least 1 h, at most 48 h.
#   2.25 = 1.5 (per-call times on the Vista gate, N=4, were ~1.5x the August logs':
#   reactant_full 16.6 vs 11.1 s, enzyme_naive 13.5 vs 9.3 s) x 1.5 safety.
#   t/call: the August per-call time where the August log has one ("aug"); else the
#   current-version sweep's per-call time scaled by the August/current ratio at the
#   largest N both have ("cur*r"); else linear in N from the largest known N.
# Columns: config<TAB>N<TAB>HH:MM:SS (comment lines are ignored by submit.sh).
#   reactant_mincut_off           N=128  t/call≈   998.5 s  (lin from N64)
#   reactant_mincut_off           N=256  t/call≈  1996.9 s  (lin from N128)
#   enzyme_naive                  N=256  t/call≈   955.5 s  (lin from N128)
